functions.name: run_local_command
functions.title: Run local command
functions.description: Queue a command for the user's connected local bridge (shell, scan, ingest, or organize). Requires a live bridge session id; returns a command id you poll via check_local_bridge.

type.description: Command type: shell runs a shell command, scan lists a folder, ingest reads a file, organize moves files per args.mapping

command.description: Shell command, folder path, or file path

args.description: Extra args, e.g. {mapping, root} for organize

functions.name: check_local_bridge
functions.title: Check local bridge
functions.description: Check whether the user's local bridge is online and list its recent commands. Read-only.

functions.name: classify_files
functions.title: Classify files
functions.description: Run the intelligent router over a list of files (path, size, ext) and return a mapping of each file path to a target category folder name. Read-only.

files.description: Array of file objects with at least a path; optional size and ext

functions.name: backup_to_drive
functions.title: Backup to Drive
functions.description: Upload a text/markdown document to the user's connected Google Drive for record keeping. Requires the user to have connected Google Drive.

content.description: Markdown or text content to upload
